source_text: The company reports 1,200 tCO2e Scope 1 and supports SDG 13.
500 low-income customers gained access to finance, aligned with SDG 1.
Women represent 55% of permanent employees and the company supports SDG 5.
note: A share without a headcount cannot populate a count metric (OI2444); was OI6213 before W5.6.

source_text: The programme created 80 permanent jobs under SDG 8.
note: Jobs created at a financed enterprise is PI3687, not total headcount OI8869.

source_text: Water consumption decreased by 12%, contributing to SDG 6.
note: A relative change is not a Water Consumed total (OI1697).

source_text: Our solar farms generated 1.8 GWh of renewable electricity in 2025, all sold to the grid.
By replacing diesel generators we avoided 920 tonnes CO2e of emissions last year.
We aim to reach net zero by 2040 and to serve 1 million customers by 2030.
note: Forward-looking: commitments are never mapped to reported metrics.

source_text: The clinic network treated 12,500 patients in rural Kenya during 2025 (SDG 3).
We sourced coffee from 3,400 smallholder farmers through our outgrower scheme.
Training reached 640 smallholder farmers who are clients of our input-finance product.
We manage 2,300 ha of land under certified organic and agroforestry practices.
The company employs 210 staff across three factories.
Our mini-grids connected 4,800 households to electricity for the first time, advancing SDG 7.
The company does not track water use and has no waste data.
note: Negation and data gaps produce no claims or metrics.

source_text: An independently audited RCT showed household income rose 18% versus a control group.
expected_claims: household income rose versus control group

source_text: In 2025 our lending app served 48,000 borrowers, 62% of them women (SDG 5, SDG 8).
note: 'borrowers' is not a recognised count unit yet; recall gap tracked here.

source_text: Annual emissions totalled 3,000 tCO2e across Scope 1, 2 and 3.
